reason: My broker already puts the same amount into index funds every month for free and I barely look at it. A pet agent rebalancing and paying for things doesn't fix anything for me, and I'm not paying a monthly fee to automate something that's already automatic.
objection: It's a demo with no named broker and no price, and I'd be giving a brand-new app's AI permission to move my real money. That's a lot of trust for something that doesn't do much more than my auto-invest already does.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker partner with insured accounts, plus proof the agent actually beats my plain monthly index buy after fees.
